findings.text: the assertion this node added here (event["fleet_verdict"]["state"] == "lane-event") does not fail at the base revision: I ran this test against the base source 81b535347 with the head test files in place and it passed. Section 34's done-when asks each of its three measures to be asserted by a test that fails at base. The same field is asserted in the new tests/test_a_lane_event_groups_by_cause.py, which does fail at base -- but there it fails on the earlier row-count assertion (two rows instead of one), so the state binding is never itself the failing assertion at base. The state is asserted against the real query.project_live_rows emitter and so is sound as regression coverage; it is recorded as a follow-on because the literal done-when (an assertion that fails at base proving this binding) is not met independently of the grouping fix.

test_every_state_the_snapshot_can_emit_has_a_colour refuses at the merged head ('light', ['lane event', 'unpromoted']); I reproduced it independently in a scratch extraction of 1506c0f2e (1 failed, EXIT=1). The test derives an emitted set from set(ticker_module.DISPLAY.values()) and asks STATE_HUE for each word, so moving the display aliases out of STATE_HUE into DISPLAY_HUE (the change section 34 instructed) leaves its lookup unanswered. This file is outside the node's write fence, so the worker correctly reported it rather than fixing it; the node that owns the file must resolve the alias through the renderer's _state_hue (or DISPLAY_HUE) so the merged head is green. Recorded so the merged-head red is not lost.
